title: Land Tax Act 2004

symbol_repair_2026_11_07.how: hand repair in place, line by line from the original Word file (the same DOCX, sha256 0617b1e03e0f45fb473bf205818781055bfcaa7c7abc9d97a38fdb311bb3f3fd); not regenerated, because the deposit's converter act_convert.py (2026-10-20) is not available and its later copy does not reproduce the deposit's line structure. Private-use code points were mapped with pua_map_inplace.py (a few lines of Python, kept outside the repository), which changes nothing but those characters; the restored lines were checked against a fresh conversion of the same DOCX.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: act_convert.py kept characters typed in the Symbol font as raw private-use code points (U+F0xx), which display as empty boxes.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: Only bullets: 14 Symbol-font bullets kept as U+F0B7 restored as "•" (lines 716-729: dictionary note 2 list of Legislation Act terms). The Word file has no w:sym character, so nothing had been dropped or turned into "?"; no decimal point, multiplication, minus, comparison sign or tick box was lost. Character count (79,636) and line structure unchanged.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: none: the subject has no encoding folder of its own; land tax is encoded in rates-act-2004/encodings/baseline-2026-10, which relies on no changed line (it takes "quarter" from the Legislation Act directly; the dictionary note only lists Legislation Act terms)
